title: Embedded Firmware/Software Developer
description:

Utveckla embedded firmware och mjukvara för avancerade elektroniksystem.
Arbeta genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från krav till verifierad funktionalitet.
Påverka både tekniska lösningar och teamets arbetssätt.

Designa och implementera robusta, högpresterande firmwarelösningar.
Förfina krav och lösningar i nära samarbete med system- och delsystemingenjörer.

Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom exempelvis elektroteknik, teknisk fysik eller datavetenskap.
Erfarenhet av FPGA-utveckling och programmering i VHDL, C++ eller liknande språk.
Vana att arbeta med komplexa system där hårdvara, firmware och mjukvara samverkar.
Förmåga att samarbeta i tvärfunktionella team och lösa tekniskt utmanande problem.

Teknik & Verktyg
FPGA och VHDL.
C++ och embeddedutveckling.
Python och MATLAB.
Versionshantering och CI/CD.
Realtids-, distribuerade och högpresterande system.

Praktisk information
Ort: Göteborg.
Arbetssätt: Ej specificerat.
Språk: Svenska och engelska.

heltid, cirka sex månader.
VHDL och/eller C++ eller liknande språk godtas. Python/MATLAB, realtids- eller distribuerade system, CI/CD, signalbehandling, radar och systemförståelse är meriterande. Eventuella krav på svenskt medborgarskap och säkerhetsprövning gäller om uppdraget omfattas av försvarssekretess.

The current hardware platform is based on a dual-processor architecture, running AUTOSAR towards the vehicle and Linux/Yocto towards the graphical engine (Qt). You will be part of an agile Scrum team of approximately eight people, including a dedicated Product Owner and Scrum Master. title: Frontier Fellow - Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
The most valuable product development happens where the product meets reality. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you work at that intersection: you turn AI agents into production-ready customer solutions and bring what you learn back into the product.
We call this role a Frontier Fellow: part senior engineer, part trusted technical advisor and part bridge between our customers, delivery teams and the HiveAI product team. HiveAI is Fellowmind's agent platform.
About the role
You belong to the HiveAI product organisation, but you will do much of your work alongside our implementation teams and customers.
Building one agent is easy now. Building agents a business can rely on every day is not. That's where you come in: you take on the hardest problems in our customer projects and solve them.
The job doesn't end when the solution works. You turn what you learn into HiveAI: when relevant, functionality, patterns and components built for one customer become reusable capabilities that help the next customer and everyone else.
What you will do
Fix the hard parts. Step in where agents meet real business systems, identity and users, and make them work. When shared components fall short, build your own.
Get AI agents into use, fast. Work with our delivery teams from the first customer conversation to go-live. Put a working first version in front of users within days.
Be a front runner. Help customers and Fellowmind teams make sound architecture decisions, challenge approaches that won't scale and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
Shape HiveAI. Share recurring requirements and architectural insights with the HiveAI development team.
Raise the bar for everyone. Share knowledge, patterns and best practices so implementation teams can deliver HiveAI successfully on their own.

What you might build
An agent that takes over a whole task, like handling supplier invoices or preparing quotes, and asks a person when a decision is needed.
An agent that works across ERP, CRM and the intranet on behalf of the person who asked.
A team of agents that share one business process, handing work to each other.
The tools, MCP servers and integrations they need.

Who are you?
You are an experienced engineer who enjoys being close to both the technology and the customer.
You can't stop building agents, and you want people to actually use them. You'd rather show something that works than a design document. You make good decisions without all the information, and you're as comfortable in a customer workshop as in a code review.
You bring:
Coding agents such as GitHub Copilot as your everyday way of working, and the judgement to know which generated code will hold up in production.
At least 4 years of professional software development experience, with strong skills in at least one programming language and solid engineering habits: branches, pull requests and tests

At Fellowmind, we're building HiveAI, a platform for developing, deploying and operating AI solutions at scale. It gives enterprises a secure and scalable foundation to move beyond isolated experiments, so AI becomes part of how the business operates.

Why Fellowmind?

Our culture is built around putting people at the heart of what we do. We value collaboration, personal responsibility, development and the freedom to find a sustainable balance between work and life.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
Join the Revolution in Commercial Vehicle Tech at Coretura!
Our AI Lab builds the shared platform that teams across Coretura use to develop and run AI products safely and reliably. We're looking for a senior software engineer to help design, build and run it.
What you’ll do
You will work with the AI Lab to set the platform's technical direction, and take on a large share of the hands-on work yourself. Together, you'll build the platform that gives teams access to AI models across providers, manages and retrieves the data their AI products rely on, and provides the harnesses agents are built and run in. You'll also build agents yourself, and the observability that shows whether an AI product is giving the right answers, not just whether it's running.
Beyond that, your work will include:

Security and safety by level: controls and evaluations that scale with how autonomous an AI system is and how safety-critical its use is, from everyday AI tools to autonomous agents, with prompt injection defences built in. The higher the level, the more a system has to prove before release and the more closely it's monitored once live. You'll build this together with our Security Hub.


Cost and resilience: usage metering built into the platform so teams can see what their AI products consume, and recovery tested for each AI product as a whole (model, knowledge base, prompts and tool integrations), not just the servers it runs on.


AI assets as code: prompts, agent definitions, model versions and evaluation datasets, versioned and released through automated pipelines. They change often and any change can shift how a product behaves, so every change is automatically tested, evaluated and traceable before it ships.


Build to discover, then share what you learn. When we need to know whether an approach works, you build a working version, then use it to help colleagues across Coretura understand what works, what doesn't and why. As a senior engineer, you'll combine those findings with your own experience to help set where the platform goes next. You'll use AI coding agents in your own daily work and help other engineers adopt them safely. You'll also review designs and code, mentor the engineers around you, and hand over ownership of components as they're ready for it.
You'll report to the AI Lab Lead and work closely with our Digital Architect and the teams behind our developer and data platforms.
What you bring
A solid background in software engineering, but we care far more about what you've done than how long you've been doing it. You've owned a production system end to end, including its roadmap, incidents and costs, and you've handed parts of it over to other engineers along the way.
You're comfortable with:

Using AI coding agents as a normal part of how you write code, with work you can show for it


Building AI applications that people can rely on: agents, retrieval (RAG), model APIs and gateways, along with the evaluations that show they behave as intended


Defining cloud infrastructure in code and shipping through CI/CD as part of how you build software, with the observability to see how it behaves once it's running


Practical security, from least privilege and secrets management to prompt injection defences


Writing well-tested, maintainable code in whatever language the problem calls for, and picking up a new one when you need to


You look for more efficient ways to build and run things, bring structure to an unclear situation without locking it down too early, and can explain a trade-off so that engineers, security and leadership all understand it. Fluent English is a must.
Why Coretura?
We're a joint venture between Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, building a shared software platform for the next generation of commercial vehicles. We're a young company with very little legacy to work around, backed by two of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers.
The AI platform serves teams across the company, so your work will directly affect how they build and ship software.
If this sounds like the work you want to do, we look forward to your application.
Next steps Ready to build the future of commercial vehicles?
We review applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours!

title: Software Developer

Zenseact is an applied automotive AI company developing world-leading safety software for AD and ADAS. Our technology encompasses every aspect of automation, from sensor fusion, computer vision, and object detection to positioning and actuation, using a combination of rule-based code and deep learning algorithms.
Our software makes a difference.
Using AI-based technology to create the ultimate driver support, we’re fighting to end car accidents and make roads safe for everyone. Every year, around 1,4 million people die in traffic while approximately 50 million people get injured. Many get disabled as a result of their injury. We can do better. And we could use your help.
One purpose, one product.
We’re a software company dedicated to revolutionizing car safety. By designing the complete software stack for autonomous driving and advanced driver-assistance systems, we’re fighting to end car accidents and make roads safe for everyone. title: Digital Marketing Specialist

title: Cloud Engineer

title: Lead Engineer Virtual Driver
description:
Company description:
.
Job description: Who are we?
 At Volvo Autonomous Solutions (V.A.S), we drive the future of transport by developing and operating cutting-edge autonomous solutions. As part of the Volvo Group, we are committed to creating a safer, more sustainable, and highly productive transport industry—guided by our ambitions of being 100% Safe, 100% Fossil-Free, and 100% More Productive. 
 We are now seeking a Lead Engineer for our Autonomous Driving software stack that we call the Virtual Driver.  
 We are turning advanced autonomous-driving technology into an industrialized product and are looking for a deeply experienced autonomous-driving engineer to shape, build, and evolve the core software stack behind our autonomous vehicles. 
 This is a deeply hands-on role: write code, debug complex system behavior, prototype solutions, and review critical implementations alongside engineers across the autonomous-driving stack. 
 Your mission  
As Lead Engineer, you will be the engineer behind our Virtual Driver, the autonomous-driving capability at the heart of our transport solution. 
 You will tackle some of the toughest challenges in autonomous driving like understanding an ever-changing worksite, deciding how to act when the drivable surface itself changes or proving safe operation across countless scenarios. Your work will shape both the Virtual Driver of today and the technology generations that follow. 
 You will move between hands-on development and system-level thinking. Staying close to the technology gives you the insight to make the architectural decisions and technical trade-offs that shape our autonomous systems and how we develop them. 
 End-to-end ownership will be central to your role. At this level, we expect you to go beyond your own code and beyond the Virtual Driver itself, working across components and with experts throughout the autonomous system to drive the best overall solution for the customer. 
 Balancing the introduction of new technology with the robustness required for production will be a key focus. That means ensuring high-quality customer releases today, while looking ahead and setting the technical direction and targets for the future. 
 Teamwork will be vital to your success. You will connect People and Technical Leaders with Virtual Driver development teams, turn ambitious targets into executable engineering solutions, and drive complex technical challenges through to resolution.  
 Own the outcome, not the activity. For us, success is an autonomous system that performs to customer needs in the real world. 
 This is not a people-management role or a pure architect role. You will lead through technical credibility, hands-on engineering, and the ability to make difficult technical decisions, while helping other engineers grow and raising the engineering capability around you. 
 Technical responsibilities  Build and improve the Virtual Driver: Develop production software in C++ and Python, prototype new solutions, debug complex system behavior, and work hands-on from simulation and data to target hardware and vehicles.  
   Lead the technical direction of Virtual Driver: Own and drive the technical evolution, architecture, and key engineering decisions. Translating product and customer needs into a robust, scalable, and evolvable system. 
   Own the complete Virtual Driver system: Drive measurable improvements in end-to-end Virtual Driver system performance, safety, quality, and product maturity. Ensure seamless integration of perception, localization, planning, control, AI, vehicle, and platform capabilities across team and component boundaries. 
   Shape how we develop autonomous systems: Set technical direction for simulation, DevOps, CI/CD, integration, validation, and developer tooling across autonomous development at V.A.S., enabling fast and scalable development loops from code to simulation, vehicle, and deployment.  
   Take autonomous driving into real operations: Drive Virtual Driver functionality from prototype through integration, validation, and release into customer operations, ensuring that real-world performance continuously feeds back into the technology.  
   Raise the engineering bar: Lead through your own implementation, technical decisions, code and design reviews, cross-team problem solving, and mentoring of experienced engineers. 
  
 
Profile description: Who are you?  
 You are the engineer people call when a problem crosses component boundaries and nobody has an obvious answer. 
 You enjoy staying technically deep. Writing software is part of how you lead. At the same time, you can step back, see the complete system, make difficult technical trade-offs, and create direction when the path forward is not obvious. 
 You build influence through technical credibility rather than hierarchy. You challenge assumptions, bring clarity to complex problems, share your expertise, and help experienced engineers grow. 
 Most importantly, you want to build autonomous technology that works in the real world. 
 You ideally bring 10–15 years of relevant engineering experience, with significant experience in autonomous driving, ADAS, robotics, or similar safety-critical software systems. More important than the exact number of years is what you have built and shipped to real customers.

title: HiveAI Engineering Manager
description:
AI is changing not only what software we build, but how we build it. As our HiveAI Engineering Manager, you will lead the team at the centre of that shift. You will combine people leadership, strong engineering judgement and AI-assisted development to turn ideas into production-ready products faster.
This is an opportunity to help shape both a product and the way of working around it. You will build and lead a small, high-trust development team where AI accelerates engineering without compromising quality, security or maintainability.
About the role
As Engineering Manager for HiveAI, you lead the people and shape how the team works and delivers. You will lead an international team with developers based across several Fellowmind countries, so building trust, alignment and a strong team culture across locations will be an important part of your leadership.
You will work as a peer alongside our Product Manager and Chief Architect, each with a clear but closely connected area of ownership. The Product Manager drives the why and what. The Chief Architect sets the technical direction and guardrails. You lead the team and create the conditions for great engineering.
The way we build matters. The HiveAI team works from problems and hypotheses, using AI to move quickly from idea to experiment and prototype. What proves valuable is then hardened into secure, scalable and maintainable software. You will help define what this way of working looks like in practice as the team grows.
You will lead a team that brings together platform developers, who build and maintain HiveAI itself, and Frontier Fellows (Forward Deployed Engineers), who work close to our implementation teams and customers and bring what they learn and build back into the product. Your job is to bring these two perspectives together as one engineering team.
What you will do:
Build and lead the team. Own hiring, 1:1s, development and performance conversations, and build a strong, high-trust engineering culture across a distributed international team.
Design the way we deliver. Drive fast build-and-learn cycles, remove impediments and favour working demos and clear ship, change or stop decisions.
Turn prototypes into products. Together with the Chief Architect, make sure promising experiments cross the line into production with the engineering quality they need.
Make AI a real engineering capability. Coach developers in prompting, coding agents, AI-assisted testing and code review, and continuously evolve how the team works with AI.
Protect engineering understanding. AI should make engineers faster and help them learn, not become a substitute for understanding the systems they build.
Keep the focus on outcomes. Build a team that makes good decisions about what to build, how to build it and when AI is, and is not, the right tool.

Who are you?
You are a people leader who still thinks like an engineer.
You probably spent a significant part of your career as a software developer before moving into technical and people leadership. Today, you might be an Engineering Manager, Software Development Manager or a Tech Lead with people responsibility, ideally in a SaaS or software product company.
You are comfortable when the destination is clearer than the route to get there. You coach and enable your team, make good decisions with incomplete information and know when a fast prototype is good enough to learn from, but not good enough to ship.
We believe that you bring:
Extensive professional experience in software development, followed by at least 2–3 years of people leadership, either as an Engineering Manager or as a Tech Lead with direct people responsibility.
Hands-on experience using AI coding tools and agents, such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code or similar, as part of real software development.
Strong engineering practices across CI/CD, automated testing, code review and secure development.
Experience from a SaaS or software product environment, where teams own what they build beyond the first release.
Experience leading distributed or international teams, with the ability to coach, communicate and build a strong team culture across locations, mainly through digital ways of working.
Experience with Azure and the Microsoft technology stack, which is highly valuable given HiveAI's technology landscape.
The ability to start from a problem statement and a hypothesis, and to shape the route to a solution together with the team as you learn.
Professional proficiency in English and the local language of the country in which you are applying: Swedish, Danish or Dutch.

You do not need to be the person writing the most code in the team. What matters is your technical background. It gives you the credibility and judgement to coach great engineers and challenge decisions. It also lets you create an environment where they can move exceptionally fast without losing control of what they build.
What is HiveAI?
At Fellowmind, we're building HiveAI, a platform for developing, deploying and operating AI solutions at scale. It provides a secure and scalable foundation for enterprise AI and enables organisations to move beyond isolated experiments towards AI solutions that become part of how the business actually operates.
At its core is the HiveAI Technology, built on Microsoft Azure, which provides the foundation for deploying, scaling and managing AI agents securely. Around it sits the HiveAI Agent Lifecycle, helping organisations develop, deploy, manage and continuously improve their AI agents over time.
Why Fellowmind?
You will join HiveAI at a stage where there is still plenty to shape. You will have real influence on how the team, the product and the way of working take form, with an international organisation and the Microsoft ecosystem behind you.
Fellowmind combines deep industry knowledge and personal guidance with Microsoft cloud technology across ERP, cloud infrastructure, data & AI, CRM, intranet and Modern Workplace. We are an international organisation with more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe.
Our culture is built around putting people at the heart of what we do. We value collaboration, personal responsibility, development and the freedom to find a sustainable balance between work and life.
